experiments.experiment_label: Intravital imaging of mRNA-LNP and siRNA-LNP spatio-temporal distribution in liver in vivo
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: Here, the spatio-temporal distribution of mRNA encoding enhanced green fluorescent protein (Egfp), siRNA, or both co-encapsulated into lipid nanoparticles (LNP) in the liver in vivo using real-time intravital imaging is investigated.
experiments.payload_or_treatment_mention: mRNA encoding enhanced green fluorescent protein (Egfp), siRNA, or both co-encapsulated
experiments.distinctness_reason: Core in vivo intravital imaging experiment comparing mRNA-LNP and siRNA-LNP uptake and Egfp translation in KC vs hepatocytes; distinct from subsequent intervention attempts.

experiments.experiment_label: Attempts to increase NPC Egfp translation via ribonuclease inhibition, pseudouridine substitution, or different ionizable lipid
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: Despite attempts such as inhibiting intracellular ribonuclease, substituting uridine bases in mRNA with pseudouridine, and using a different ionizable lipid in the LNP mixture, no substantial increase in Egfp translation by NPC is possible.
experiments.formulation_or_delivery_system_mention: LNP mixture with different ionizable lipid
experiments.payload_or_treatment_mention: Egfp mRNA with pseudouridine substitution; intracellular ribonuclease inhibitor
experiments.distinctness_reason: Distinct intervention experiments testing ribonuclease inhibition, pseudouridine substitution, and alternative ionizable lipid to improve NPC translation; different treatments from the core imaging experiment.

experiments.experiment_label: Comparison of total RNA, protein, and ribosomal protein levels between hepatocytes and other liver cells
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: The investigation reveals that hepatocytes, which are distinct from other liver cells due to their polyploidy, exhibit significantly elevated levels of total RNA and protein, along with a higher proportion of ribosomal protein per individual cell.
experiments.distinctness_reason: Distinct molecular characterization experiment measuring total RNA, protein, and ribosomal protein per cell, linking polyploidy to translational capacity; no LNP or payload involved.
